title: Rethinking the Roles of Diffusion and Decoding: Predictive-State Flows for Parallel Language Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12898v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In continuous diffusion language models (DLMs), latents generated by the diffusion prior are mapped almost deterministically to tokens, either by a decoder or through a token embedding matrix. Unlike in image generation, where visual details can vary continuously, the diffusion prior must capture fine-grained discrete token choices in continuous space, which can make the joint latent distribution difficult to model. We argue that generative roles should instead be divided: the diffusion prior should generate high-level predictive information, while the decoder should resolve the remaining token-level choices. Based on this view, we introduce Predictive-State Flows (PSF), which partitions a sequence into blocks and associates each block with a predictive state computed solely from the preceding context. A rectified-flow prior generates the sequence of predictive states, after which a block-causal decoder generates all blocks in parallel,

translated_title: 重新思考扩散与解码的角色：用于并行语言生成的预测态流
translated_abstract: 在连续扩散语言模型（DLMs）中，由扩散先验生成的潜变量几乎确定性地被映射到词元，映射方式要么通过解码器，要么通过词元嵌入矩阵。与图像生成不同——图像中视觉细节可以连续变化——扩散先验必须在连续空间中捕捉细粒度的离散词元选择，这可能使得联合潜分布难以建模。我们主张应当重新划分生成角色：扩散先验应当生成高层次的预测信息，而解码器则负责解决剩余的词元级选择。基于这一观点，我们提出了预测态流（Predictive-State Flows, PSF），该方法将序列划分为多个块，并将每个块与一个仅由前文上下文计算得到的预测态相关联。一个整流流先验生成预测态序列，随后一个块因果解码器并行生成所有块。
tldr: 该论文提出预测态流（PSF），重新划分扩散先验与解码器的生成职责，让整流流先验仅生成基于前文的高层预测态，再由块因果解码器并行完成词元级选择，从而实现并行语言生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Predictive-State Flows (PSF), which reassigns generative roles so that a rectified-flow prior generates high-level predictive states from preceding context while a block-causal decoder resolves token-level choices in parallel for language generation.
